description: Switch the project to another art style, a built-in id (list_styles) or one of the person's own (my_styles). Every shot is rebuilt in the new style: its characters, objects and places are replaced; words, cameras and timing stay. One undo step, and no confirm step, so ask the person first if the project has work. A style built since Dinoctor opened makes the window reload once. For built-in styles with a confirm step, set_style does the same.

id.description: A style id from list_styles or my_styles.

name: use_style
